fix.match_no_server: A match waits until a server is free. Start a stopped server on the Servers page, or wait for one to finish. If all of them are running, the license may be full.
fix.veto_stalled: Open the match to see whose turn it is, and nudge that captain.
fix.warmup_long: Some players aren't ready. The match page shows who is missing: force them ready if they're there, or decide the match.
fix.match_forfeit: Check the result on the match page. If it was a mistake, restart the match from there.
fix.report_disputed: The two teams reported different results. Open the match, compare the reports and set the result.
fix.failover: Nothing to do: the match moves to another server by itself. You can follow it here.
fix.failoverDecision: Choose on this page: move the match to another server, restore a round, or decide it.
fix.match_silent: Its server stopped sending updates. Check it on the Servers page and restart it if it hangs.
fix.server_crashed: Check the server on this page. It restarts by itself; if it keeps crashing, look at its console.
fix.plugin_update_available: Update Ready Up on this page. A server in a match updates once the match is over.
fix.update_failed: Try the update again on this page. If it fails again, the error above says why.
fix.autoscale_license: Every server the license covers is running. Free one, or add servers to the license.
fix.recorder_offline: Check the recorder's machine: is it on, and is its container running?
fix.recorder_update_failed: Update it again from this page, or run start-recorder.sh on its machine.
fix.benchmark_failed: Run the benchmark again from this page. If it fails again, check the recorder's GPU and its CS2.
fix.clips_failing: Open a recorder's recent runs on this page to see why the clips failed.
fix.beta_available: Update when it suits you, between tournaments.
fix.license_problem: The license page says what needs doing.
fix.demos_failing: The logs on this page say why the demo analyses failed.
fix.tournament_autostart_failed: Fix what the reason says, then start the tournament by hand.
fix.shuffle_no_show: Nothing to do: they're left out of the next draws until they say they're back.
fix.discord_failed: Check that the bot is in the Discord server and has Manage Channels, Manage Roles and Move Members (Settings → Integrations → Discord bot).
